items.title: Unisoc VoLTE Video Call Exploit Chain Can Give Attackers Full Android Kernel Access
items.summary: Security researchers at SSD Secure Disclosure have published a two-stage exploit chain that achieves full Android kernel access on devices running Unisoc modem firmware through a VoLTE video call, with no fix from the chipset maker.
